The '''Temple of Shadows''' is an area located deep within [[Stormwrought Descent]] in [[Stormwrought Ruins]]. It is here that [[Ighal'for]] seeks to summon the beholder [[Mergothid]] to [[Azeroth]] and usher in a new uprising.
